    The mesh derivative and the brick hypothesis #

    Section 5 of the manuscript (mesh-deformations.tex).

    • The derivative D_m (eq:mesh-derivative): for a family f = (f_a)_a of morphisms parallel to the arrows, (D_m f)_x = ∑_{a : y → x} c_{x,a} (f_{σ a} a + (σ a) f_a). It is recorded here as a function on all parallel families; the manuscript restricts it to families of path degree m, with values of degree m + 1.
    • The object quotient C/[Σ] by the ideal generated by the identities of a set Σ of objects, and the brick hypothesis (Subsection 5.2): every object quotient that is not zero has an object whose endomorphism ring is k.
